title: Bootstrap "Initialize metadata branch" commit is not signed, blocked by signed-commit rulesets

verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the signing work for checkpoint commits (SignCommitBestEffort, the opt-out setting, signer refactor), but none of it mentions the orphan bootstrap commit in common.go or says it should stay unsigned. The missing signing call looks like an omission, not a choice.

evidence.text:
Make SignCommitBestEffort truly best-effort and add sign_checkpoint_commits setting

SignCommitBestEffort now logs errors via the logging package instead of
returning them, so users with hardware security keys or other signers
requiring physical presence won't have checkpoint commits blocked.

Add sign_checkpoint_commits setting (default: true) to let users opt out
of signing checkpoint commits entirely via .entire/settings.json.

Thread context.Context through CreateCommit, createCommit, updateRef,
createMergeCommitCommon, createCherryPickCommit, and related helpers so
that signing warnings flow to .entire/logs/ like all other operational
messages.

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
